items.summaryZh: 由于中东局势，2026年F1巴林大奖赛将改在马来西亚雪邦赛道举行，远离其传统的巴林国际赛道主场。雪邦上一次举办大奖赛是在2017年，如今车队和车手几乎将其视为一条全新赛道。
items.titleEn: What time is F1's 2026 Bahrain GP in Malaysia? Full weekend schedule
items.summaryEn: Due to the ongoing situation in the Middle East, the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix will be held at the Sepang circuit in Malaysia, far from its traditional home at the Bahrain International Circuit. Sepang last hosted a grand prix in 2017, and teams and drivers are essentially treating it as a brand-new track.

items.titleZh: F1计划在2027年使用更高衰退率的轮胎以减少一停比赛
items.summaryZh: F1希望在2027年引入更高衰退率的轮胎，以减少像阿塞拜疆大奖赛那样的一停比赛。今年15场大奖赛中有9场大部分车手都采用一停策略，这一定程度上源于2026年轮胎的开发方式。
items.titleEn: F1's plan for higher-degradation tyres in 2027
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 is aiming to introduce higher-degradation tyres in 2027, which could reduce one-stop races such as the Azerbaijan Grand Prix. Nine of the 15 grands prix so far this year have been one-stop races for most of the field, partly a consequence of how the 2026 tyres were developed.

items.titleEn: Everything we learned from F1's 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: The 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix delivered major drama, with the reigning world champion calling for another driver to be banned, two team-mate collisions and the closest finish since 2002. Lando Norris felt Franco Colapinto deserved a race ban for the accident he caused at the first safety car restart in Baku, but most peers and the stewards disagreed, handing him only a five-place grid penalty for Malaysia.

items.summaryEn: Red Bull brought its final significant upgrade package for the RB22 to Baku, with technical director Pierre Waché reporting good correlation between track and wind tunnel data. Max Verstappen says the team is finally making progress on the car degradation problem that has troubled them for years.

items.titleEn: F1 rejects Hamilton's idea for managing dangerous Baku closing speeds
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 teams have rejected Lewis Hamilton's proposal to tweak energy management rules at Baku to reduce dangerous closing speeds in the final corners. Hamilton received a reprimand for impeding Liam Lawson in practice.

items.titleEn: David Coulthard warns "heads will roll" if Williams FW48 upgrade fails
items.summaryEn: Former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard has warned that "heads will roll" if Williams's FW48 upgrade fails to deliver an immediate step forward in performance. Williams has struggled all season with an overweight car and sits ninth in the constructors' championship with 11 points after 14 rounds.

items.titleEn: Why Mercedes’ huge Baku practice advantage may not be the real picture
items.summaryEn: Mercedes dominated Thursday's practice sessions in Baku, with George Russell fastest in both sessions while Max Verstappen was the closest rival at 0.827s adrift, though the team stressed this advantage does not reflect the true picture for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 奥迪巴库带来14项气动升级，比诺托称符合预期

items.titleEn: 'The package is delivering as expected' – Audi reflect on new upgrade package after practice ahead of 2026 Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: Audi brought 14 aerodynamic upgrade components to Baku ahead of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, with Team Principal Mattia Binotto saying the first impression from the data is that the package is delivering as expected. Only Gabriel Bortoleto ran the new package in FP1, and the two cars finished P14 and P15 in FP2.

items.titleEn: What's going on with F1's uncertain final 2026 races
items.summaryEn: F1 is waiting to see how the situation in the Middle East unfolds before deciding whether the 2026 season finale rounds in Qatar and Abu Dhabi can go ahead as planned, while preparations have begun at Imola as a contingency venue if a switch is needed.

items.titleEn: Jacques Villeneuve identifies barrier facing female F1 drivers after Jamie Chadwick Williams test
items.summaryEn: 1997 Formula 1 champion Jacques Villeneuve says the lack of female drivers on the current grid is fundamentally a numbers game. Three-time W Series champion Jamie Chadwick, who this week became the first woman in over a decade to test a Williams F1 car, pointed to the shortage of available F1 seats but said her test proved it is physically possible for a woman to drive the machinery.

items.titleZh: 库特哈德：拉塞尔需“重塑思维”以应对安东内利的挑战

items.titleEn: George Russell forced to "rewire his brain" amid Kimi Antonelli struggles, says David Coulthard
items.summaryEn: Former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard says George Russell is being forced to "rewire his brain" as he struggles to consistently match his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli. Russell was considered one of the favourites for the 2026 title heading into the season, but after winning the Australian Grand Prix and the Chinese sprint race, he watched on as his teenage team-mate took the lead of the standings.

items.titleEn: How Lando Norris gets better at F1 with a Hypercar test
items.summaryEn: Reigning world champion Lando Norris drove McLaren's new Hypercar, the MCL-HY, at Algarve last week, completing 38 laps and providing feedback to the team ahead of its 2027 debut. He believes the test can help improve his Formula 1 performances.

items.titleZh: 格罗斯让：梅赛德斯没有「挖坑」，而是托举安东内利更上一层楼

items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton believes Ferrari's season can still rank as a "huge achievement" if they finish in the top three of the Drivers' Championship, asking critics to "look at the positives" of the team's year despite recent setbacks.

items.titleEn: What’s behind the delay in cancelling the Qatar and Abu Dhabi GPs?
items.summaryEn: Due to the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, it has been assumed for several months that the cancellation of the season-closing Qatar and Abu Dhabi Grands Prix is not just likely but inevitable, yet the decision has been slow to come.

items.summaryEn: This article outlines the believed contract lengths of each F1 driver and analyzes possible future driver moves and their timing. Among them, McLaren driver Lando Norris recently announced a new four-year contract with the team, believed to run until 2030.

items.titleZh: 帕尔默：安东内利毫无冠军压力迹象，2026赛季逆转获盛赞
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手、F1 TV评论员乔利恩·帕尔默表示，梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利在冲击个人首个总冠军的过程中表现出毫无冠军压力的迹象。安东内利在西班牙大奖赛赢得赛季第八胜后，以81分领先优势结束欧洲赛季。
items.titleEn: Kimi Antonelli shows "zero sign" of championship pressure as Jolyon Palmer hails 2026 turnaround
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver and F1 TV pundit Jolyon Palmer says Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli is showing zero sign of championship pressure as he closes in on his maiden title. After winning his eighth race of the season at the Spanish Grand Prix, Antonelli ended the European leg with an 81-point lead.

items.titleZh: 未来F1引擎规则首批细节曝光

items.titleEn: First details of future F1 engine rules revealed
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 stakeholders have reached an agreement on the main elements of the next engine rules cycle. The FIA and F1 engine manufacturers have opted against a naturally aspirated option, partly because of noise restrictions at street circuits, with a smaller and simplified electronics package.

items.titleZh: 奥康自称自由身，哈斯尚未决定2027年F1车手阵容

items.summaryEn: Red Bull have announced that Isack Hadjar will remain with the team for the 2027 season.

items.titleZh: Hinchcliffe称汉密尔顿与法拉利2026争冠希望已破灭
items.summaryZh: 前IndyCar车手、F1 TV评论员James Hinchcliffe表示，在西班牙大奖赛遭遇代价高昂的退赛后，刘易斯·汉密尔顿与法拉利的2026年F1总冠军希望已经"破灭"。汉密尔顿在全新的马德里赛道赛道遭遇刹车问题，目前在积分榜上落后领跑者安东内利 101分。
items.summaryEn: Former IndyCar driver and F1 TV pundit James Hinchcliffe has declared Lewis Hamilton and Ferrari's 2026 Formula 1 championship hopes "over" following a costly retirement at the Spanish Grand Prix. Hamilton suffered a brake issue at the brand-new Madring circuit and now sits 101 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli.

items.titleZh: 加斯利谴责因科拉平托事件遭受的"令人不安"辱骂
items.summaryZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利公开谴责他与家人（包括女友）在社交媒体上收到的"令人不安"的辱骂和威胁，此事与他在西班牙大奖赛阻挡队友科拉平托有关。
items.titleEn: Gasly hits out at 'disturbing' abuse over Colapinto incident
items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly has publicly condemned "disturbing" abuse and threats he and his family members, including his girlfriend, received on social media following the incident in which he held up his Alpine team-mate Franco Colapinto at the Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 红牛确认哈贾尔2027赛季留队
items.summaryZh: 红牛车队已确认，伊萨克·哈贾尔将在2027年F1赛季继续留队，担任马克斯·维斯塔潘的队友。
items.titleEn: Hadjar to remain at Red Bull for 2027
items.summaryEn: Red Bull have confirmed that Isack Hadjar will remain as Max Verstappen's team-mate for the 2027 Formula 1 season.

items.titleZh: 红牛正式留用哈贾尔，2027赛季搭档维斯塔潘
items.summaryZh: 红牛官方确认，伊萨克·哈贾尔将在2027赛季继续留在红牛F1车队，担任马克斯·维斯塔潘的队友。车队在阿塞拜疆大奖赛哈贾尔伤愈复出之际宣布了这一消息。
items.titleEn: Red Bull extends Hadjar in main F1 team
items.summaryEn: Red Bull has officially confirmed that Isack Hadjar will remain with the team for the 2027 Formula 1 season as Max Verstappen's team-mate. The announcement was made at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix as Hadjar returned from injury.

items.titleZh: 红牛确认2027赛季车手阵容不变，哈贾尔继续搭档维斯塔潘
items.summaryZh: 红牛已确认2027赛季F1车手阵容保持不变，伊萨克·哈贾尔将继续与马克斯·维斯塔潘搭档。哈贾尔在2026年从姊妹车队小红牛的新秀赛季后升入红牛，并在这一历史上颇具挑战性的红牛二号席位上展现出速度。
items.titleEn: Red Bull retains Isack Hadjar alongside Max Verstappen for F1 2027
items.summaryEn: Red Bull has confirmed it will field an unchanged Formula 1 driver line-up in 2027, with Isack Hadjar staying alongside Max Verstappen. Hadjar stepped up in 2026 after a rookie season at sister team Racing Bulls and has impressed with his speed in what has historically been a difficult second Red Bull seat.

items.titleZh: 红牛确认哈贾尔2027年席位
items.summaryZh: 红牛车队确认伊萨克·哈贾尔2027年将继续留在队中，这对哈贾尔来说是美好的24小时。
items.titleEn: A good 24 hours for Isack Hadjar, as Red Bull confirms his seat with the team for 2027 #F1
items.summaryEn: A good 24 hours for Isack Hadjar, as Red Bull confirms his seat with the team for 2027 #F1

items.titleZh: 威廉姆斯巴库升级：为时已晚？
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯为阿塞拜疆大奖赛带来以减重为主、兼有空气动力学改动的大型升级包，但车队本赛季表现远低于预期，目前仅列第九。The 比赛播客嘉宾认为，这次升级只能让车队回到本应更早达到的位置，难以改变竞争格局。
items.titleEn: Too little too late? What's resting on Williams's Baku upgrade
items.summaryEn: Williams is bringing a major upgrade package to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix focused largely on weight reduction with some aerodynamic changes, but the team has fallen far below expectations this season and sits ninth in the standings. Guests on The Race F1 Podcast argued the upgrade will only bring the team back to where it should have been much earlier and is unlikely to change its competitive position.

items.titleZh: 舒马赫与塞纳职业生涯珍稀物品将被拍卖
items.summaryZh: 据The 比赛 Team报道，舒马赫和塞纳职业生涯中关键且不寻常时刻的签名物品将在BUDDS拍卖。相关报道还提及MotoGP的制动技术专家正在为2027年的重大规则变化做准备。
items.titleEn: Unique items from Schumacher and Senna's careers auctioned
items.summaryEn: According to The Race Team, signed items from key and unusual moments in the careers of Michael Schumacher and Ayrton Senna will be auctioned at BUDDS. Related coverage also mentions how MotoGP's brake specialists are preparing for major changes in 2027.

items.titleZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛六大F1技术看点
items.summaryZh: F1将前往巴库开启三连赛的首站，这条赛道对空气动力学效率要求极高，各车队在技术层面有六个值得关注的方面。
items.titleEn: Six F1 tech talking points at the Azerbaijan GP
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 heads to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the first race of a punishing triple-header that could prove defining for the world championship, with six technical storylines worth watching.

items.titleZh: 法拉利设定巴库目标，罗斯伯格指出车队重复性缺陷
items.summaryZh: 法拉利领队瓦塞尔强调车队必须在巴库更干净利落地执行整个比赛周末，而罗斯伯格指出法拉利反复出现的策略与沟通缺陷是其致命弱点。
items.titleEn: Ferrari boss Frederic Vasseur sets goal for Azerbaijan GP as Nico Rosberg pinpoints team's 'Achilles' heel'
items.summaryEn: Ferrari boss Frederic Vasseur stressed the need to execute the Baku weekend more cleanly, while Nico Rosberg pinpointed Ferrari's recurring weaknesses in strategy and communication as their Achilles' heel.

items.titleZh: 逃离F1泡沫后我学到了什么
items.summaryZh: The 比赛的Scott Mitchell-Malm在休陪产假离开F1三个月后，分享了他以车迷视角观看比赛的新认识，包括对冲刺赛周末的意外好感以及对2026规则和F1官方宣传的批评。
items.titleEn: What I learned escaping the F1 bubble
items.summaryEn: The Race's Scott Mitchell-Malm shares what he learned after stepping away from F1 for three months on paternity leave, including a newfound appreciation for sprint weekends and criticism of the 2026 rules and F1's messaging.

items.titleZh: F1正赛为何是305公里？1950至2027年赛程距离演变
items.summaryZh: F1正赛距离由超过305公里所需的最少圈数决定，摩纳哥以260公里为例外；从1950年无统一标准到1989年确立305公里规则，2027年标准将降至290公里。
items.titleEn: F1 race distance: Why 305km and what changes in 2027
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 race distances are determined by the minimum number of laps required to exceed 305 kilometres, with Monaco as the only exception at 260 kilometres. From no standardised distance in 1950 to the 305-kilometre rule set in 1989, the standard is set to drop to 290 kilometres in 2027.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔谈续约法拉利前的"其他机会"
items.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔在F1的Beyond the Grid播客节目中被问及是否认真考虑过离开法拉利，他表示自己很幸运拥有经纪人来处理这些事务。
items.titleEn: What were Leclerc's "other opportunities" before signing new Ferrari deal?
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc revealed on F1's Beyond the Grid podcast that he received approaches from rival teams before signing a new Ferrari deal, but he remains coy about which teams they were.

items.titleZh: F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛前瞻：五大看点
items.summaryZh: 本周末F1重返阿塞拜疆，巴库街道赛道迎来进入赛历十周年。由于阿塞拜疆周日举行纪念日，大奖赛周末整体提前一天，比赛改在周六举行。
items.titleEn: Five things to look out for at the F1 Azerbaijan GP
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 returns to Azerbaijan this weekend as the Baku street circuit celebrates its 10th anniversary on the calendar. Because Azerbaijan holds its Remembrance Day on Sunday, the grand prix weekend has been shifted forward by a day, with the race now taking place on Saturday.

items.titleZh: 2026年F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛完整周末赛程公布
items.summaryZh: The 比赛发布了2026年F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛的完整周末赛程，比赛因阿塞拜疆全国悼念日而整体提前一天，改在周六举行。
items.titleEn: What time is F1's 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix? Full weekend schedule
items.summaryEn: The Race has released the full weekend schedule for the 2026 Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix, with the race moved one day earlier to Saturday because of Azerbaijan's national Remembrance Day.

items.titleZh: 加里·安德森解析F1主动式后翼四种概念的工作原理
items.summaryZh: 加里·安德森撰文指出，巴库赛道与蒙扎类似，直线速度对表现至关重要，并解析了2026年F1主动空气动力学规则下不同后翼概念的工作原理。
items.titleEn: How each active F1 rear wing concept works - Gary Anderson explains
items.summaryEn: Gary Anderson explains that Baku, like Monza, rewards straightline speed heavily, and breaks down how the different rear wing concepts work under Formula 1's new-for-2026 active aerodynamic regulations.

items.titleZh: 土耳其大奖赛大规模回归改革内幕
items.summaryZh: 土耳其大奖赛与F1签署五年协议，将于2027年重返赛历。赛事方计划扩建围场、改善交通与观众体验，并首次获得政府全面支持。
items.titleEn: Inside Turkey's massive F1 return revamp
items.summaryEn: The Turkish Grand Prix has signed a five-year deal to return to the F1 calendar in 2027. Organizers plan to expand the paddock, improve traffic and fan experience, and have secured full government backing for the first time.

items.titleZh: 哈贾尔回归，红牛2026年F1车手阵容各就各位
items.summaryZh: 红牛在阿塞拜疆大奖赛恢复其2026年F1首选车手阵容，伊萨克·哈贾尔伤愈回归，利亚姆·劳森回到小红牛，角田裕毅重新担任储备车手。
items.titleEn: Where every Red Bull driver stands as Hadjar returns
items.summaryEn: Red Bull restores its first-choice 2026 F1 driver line-up at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix as Isack Hadjar returns from injury, Liam Lawson heads back to Racing Bulls, and Yuki Tsunoda resumes his reserve-driver role.

items.titleZh: 詹姆斯·梅：偶像贬低我的菲亚特Panda，令人难过
items.summaryZh: 詹姆斯·梅在X发帖称，自己的偶像之一贬低了他的菲亚特Panda，并引用了蒂夫·尼德尔关于前轮驱动不利于驾驶乐趣的言论。
items.titleEn: It’s a sad day when one of my heroes disses my Fiat Panda.
items.summaryEn: It’s a sad day when one of my heroes disses my Fiat Panda.Tiff Needell 🏁: No power should ever go to the front wheels if you want true driving enjoyment ...

items.titleZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔将在F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛重返红牛
items.summaryZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔在夏季休赛期训练中手腕受伤，遵医嘱避免驾驶以利恢复，因而缺席了此前比赛，由利亚姆·劳森代其出战红牛。如今哈贾尔已康复，将在本周末于巴库举行的阿塞拜疆大奖赛重返红牛，劳森则回到小红牛。
items.titleEn: Isack Hadjar to make Red Bull return at F1 Azerbaijan GP
items.summaryEn: Isack Hadjar will return to Red Bull for this weekend's Azerbaijan Grand Prix at Baku after recovering from a wrist injury, as Liam Lawson moves back to Racing Bulls. Hadjar had injured his wrist in training over the summer break and, following medical advice, was told to avoid driving to manage his recovery.

items.titleZh: 哈贾尔获准在阿塞拜疆大奖赛复出
items.summaryZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔在夏季休赛期手腕骨折后已康复，将代表红牛车队在F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛中重返赛场。
items.titleEn: Hadjar cleared to return for Azerbaijan GP
items.summaryEn: Isack Hadjar has recovered from a fractured wrist suffered during the summer break and will return to action for Red Bull at Formula 1's Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 红牛确认哈贾尔伤愈复出，劳森回归小红牛
items.summaryZh: 红牛确认伊萨克·哈贾尔手腕伤愈，本周末将重返赛车。利亚姆·劳森在代打三场比赛后回归小红牛，角田裕毅再次担任储备车手。
items.titleEn: Red Bull confirms Isack Hadjar will be back in the car this weekend after recovering from his wrist injury Liam Lawson returns to Racing Bulls after t...
items.summaryEn:
Red Bull confirms Isack Hadjar will be back in the car this weekend after recovering from his wrist injury
Liam Lawson returns to Racing Bulls after three races as a replacement for Hadjar, and Yuki Tsunoda is on reserve duties again #F1 #AzerbaijanGP

items.titleZh: Doriane Pin鼓励年轻女孩投身赛车运动：敢于相信自己
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯F1发展车手、2025年F1学院冠军Doriane Pin鼓励有志于从事赛车运动的年轻女孩“敢于相信自己”的抱负。
items.titleEn: Doriane Pin shares powerful advice to young girls hoping to reach motorsport
items.summaryEn: Mercedes Formula 1 development driver and 2025 F1 Academy champion Doriane Pin has encouraged young girls pursuing motorsport careers to "dare to believe" in their ambitions.

items.titleZh: 红牛车手哈贾尔将在阿塞拜疆大奖赛伤愈复出
items.summaryZh: 红牛车手伊萨克·哈贾尔因手腕伤势缺席三场比赛后，将在阿塞拜疆大奖赛重返赛场。
items.titleEn: Isack Hadjar: Red Bull driver to return to action at Azerbaijan GP after missing three races with wrist injury
items.summaryEn: Red Bull driver Isack Hadjar will return to action at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix after missing three races with a wrist injury.

items.titleZh: F1首个三连赛周末开启，阿塞拜疆大奖赛领衔
items.summaryZh: F1本周迎来本赛季首个三连赛，阿塞拜疆大奖赛是三周内连续三场比赛中的第一场，随后是马来西亚和新加坡站。
items.titleEn: F1 title race: Why Azerbaijan-Malaysia-Singapore triple header will shape what rest of 2026 championship chase will look like
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 embarks on its first triple header of the season this week, with the Azerbaijan Grand Prix the first of three races in as many weekends, followed by Malaysia and Singapore.

items.titleZh: F1确认2027年推出Hot Wheels《Infinite Rush》赛车合集
items.summaryZh: F1宣布，2026赛季全部22辆官方车队赛车将通过全新的F1 Car Collection Pack加入Hot Wheels Infinite Rush电子游戏，该可下载内容包将于2027年3月推出。该内容包由Milestone与Mattel共同开发，这将是官方F1赛车首次可在该游戏中驾驶。
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 has announced that all 22 official team cars from the 2026 season will be added to the Hot Wheels Infinite Rush video game via a new F1 Car Collection Pack, launching in March 2027. The downloadable content pack, developed with Milestone and Mattel, will mark the first time official F1 machinery is playable in a Hot Wheels franchise game.

items.titleZh: F1批准2027赛季缩短比赛距离以配合新动力单元方案
items.summaryZh: F1委员会已批准2027赛季将标准大奖赛里程从305公里缩短至290公里，以配合新动力单元变化并降低成本，该决定尚待国际汽联世界汽车运动理事会批准。
items.titleEn: F1 approves shorter races for 2027 to fit revised power unit plan
items.summaryEn: The Formula 1 Commission has approved reducing the standard grand prix distance from 305km to 290km for 2027 to align with the new power unit changes and reduce costs, pending approval from the FIA World Motor Sport Council.

items.titleZh: F1批准2027年缩短大奖赛赛程计划
items.summaryZh: F1委员会已同意从2027年起缩短大奖赛赛程，以应对燃油流量增加带来的油箱和成本压力。该计划尚需国际汽联世界汽车运动理事会正式批准。
items.titleEn: F1 approves plan for shorter grands prix in 2027
items.summaryEn: The F1 Commission has agreed to shorten grand prix race distances from 2027 to address fuel tank and cost pressures caused by increased fuel flow rates. The plan still requires formal approval from the FIA World Motor Sport Council.

items.titleZh: Jamie Chadwick 谈代表女性车手的压力
items.summaryZh: 三届 W Series 冠军 Jamie Chadwick 坦言，作为单座赛车阶梯中备受关注的女性车手，她表现不佳时往往会被过度审视，并被视作其性别的反映。她在 Significant Figures 播客节目中谈及代表女性参与赛车运动的压力，表示自己确实感受到这种压力，但更多是因为当自己速度不够快时，只想慢下来。
items.summaryEn: Three-time W Series champion Jamie Chadwick has admitted that being a prominent female driver on the single-seater ladder meant her off days were often heavily scrutinised as a reflection of her gender. Speaking on the Significant Figures podcast, Chadwick opened up about the pressure of representing women in motorsport, saying she did feel it but more because when she wasn't fast, she just wanted to be slow.

items.titleZh: F1确认2027赛季比赛距离将略有缩短
items.summaryZh: 国际汽联（FIA）已确认，2027赛季F1比赛的赛程距离将略有缩短，从305公里减至290公里，同时引入比赛日的“硬性停止”时间。
items.titleEn: F1 Grand Prix distances set to be reduced for 2027 season along with introduction of 'hard stop' time on race days
items.summaryEn: The FIA has confirmed that Formula 1 race distances will be slightly reduced for the 2027 season, from 305km to 290km, along with the introduction of a 'hard stop' time on race days.

items.titleZh: FIA拟调整ADUO规则以助本田，或引发系统大改
items.summaryZh: 据The 比赛报道，FIA正在评估对ADUO规则进行修改，计划在2027年实施，旨在让追赶机制在前部更好地发挥作用，同时帮助处于后部的本田。
items.titleEn: FIA's Honda help could trigger major ADUO system revamp
items.summaryEn: The FIA is evaluating potential tweaks to the ADUO rules for 2027, aiming to make the catch-up mechanism work better at the front and help Honda at the back, according to The Race.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦确认将在阿塞拜疆大奖赛带来更多升级，预计巴库将上演四方争冠
items.summaryZh: 迈凯伦确认将在本周末的阿塞拜疆大奖赛为MCL40带来更多升级，并预计将在巴库与梅赛德斯、法拉利和红牛展开四方争冠。
items.titleEn: Azerbaijan GP: McLaren predict four-way battle for victory with rivals in Baku after confirming more upgrades to MCL40
items.summaryEn: McLaren have confirmed more upgrades to the MCL40 for this weekend's Azerbaijan Grand Prix and expect a four-way battle for victory in Baku against Mercedes, Ferrari and Red Bull.

items.titleZh: 塞恩斯建议威廉姆斯青训车手格林优先探索极限
items.summaryZh: 卡洛斯·塞恩斯建议威廉姆斯F1青训车手威尔·格林在从卡丁车转向单座赛车时，应优先寻找极限而非追求稳定性。格林于2024年12月被宣布为威廉姆斯赛车学院车手，近期成为2026年卡丁车欧洲锦标赛青年组冠军。
items.titleEn: Carlos Sainz backs bold approach for Williams junior Will Green's racing future
items.summaryEn: Carlos Sainz has advised Williams F1 junior Will Green to prioritise finding the limits over consistency as he prepares to move from karting to single-seaters. Green was announced as a Williams Racing Academy driver in December 2024 and recently became the 2026 Karting European Championship junior champion.

items.titleZh: 施泰纳预测维斯塔潘2026赛季将一胜难求
items.summaryZh: 前哈斯F1车队领队京特·施泰纳认为，四届世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘在2026赛季将无法赢得任何一场大奖赛，理由是红牛的整体竞争力不足。目前维斯塔潘以145分位列车手积分榜第六，落后榜首的基米·安东内利147分。
items.titleEn: Guenther Steiner predicts Max Verstappen will go winless in 2026 F1 season
items.summaryEn: Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner believes four-time champion Max Verstappen will fail to win a single grand prix during the 2026 F1 season, arguing that Red Bull's package is not competitive enough. Verstappen currently sits sixth in the standings with 145 points, 147 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli.

items.titleZh: Doriane Pin设定五年内争取F1正赛车手席位
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯F1发展车手Doriane Pin设定了五年目标，希望获得F1发车格上的正赛车手席位，并表示相信女性车手能够达到冠军水平。
items.titleEn: 2025 F1 Academy champion Doriane Pin sets timeline for Formula 1 race seat
items.summaryEn: Mercedes F1 development driver Doriane Pin has set a five-year target to secure a race seat on the F1 grid, expressing her belief that female drivers can reach championship level.

items.titleZh: 博尔托莱托谈阿隆索：镜头前后性格一致
items.summaryZh: 奥迪F1车手加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托表示，他的经纪人、两届世界冠军费尔南多·阿隆索在幕后与媒体面前完全一样，并称自己很喜欢阿隆索的讽刺幽默。
items.titleEn: Gabriel Bortoleto opens up on Fernando Alonso's personality away from F1 cameras
items.summaryEn: Audi Formula 1 driver Gabriel Bortoleto says his manager, two-time champion Fernando Alonso, is exactly the same behind the scenes as he appears in the media, adding that he loves Alonso's sarcasm.

items.titleZh: Szafnauer质疑凯迪拉克美英分设架构不利于争冠
items.summaryZh: 前阿尔派车队领队Otmar Szafnauer警告称，凯迪拉克的运营架构并非以争夺世界冠军为目标。凯迪拉克于2026赛季作为第11支车队加入F1，其设计与模拟工作大量在美国进行，同时在银石设有欧洲基地。
items.titleEn: Otmar Szafnauer raises concern over Cadillac's "suboptimal" split US-UK structure
items.summaryEn: Former Alpine team principal Otmar Szafnauer has warned that Cadillac's operational structure is not geared towards winning a world championship. Cadillac joined the F1 grid in 2026 as the 11th team, with much of its design and simulation work taking place in the United States while also opening a European facility in Silverstone.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦发布诺里斯超级跑车测试幕后视频
items.summaryZh: 迈凯伦发布了兰多·诺里斯在葡萄牙测试MCL-HY超级跑车的幕后视频，诺里斯完成38圈、共177公里。
items.titleEn: McLaren releases behind-the-scenes look at Lando Norris's hypercar test
items.summaryEn: McLaren has released behind-the-scenes footage of Lando Norris testing the MCL-HY hypercar in Portugal, where he completed 38 laps and drove a total of 177km.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔解释为何未模仿汉密尔顿驾驶风格
items.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔解释，在法拉利SF-26赛车难以驾驭时，他没有尝试复制队友汉密尔顿的驾驶风格，而是选择调整赛车以适应自己的自然驾驶方式，并在银石取得突破后赢得英国大奖赛。
items.titleEn: Why Charles Leclerc didn’t copy Lewis Hamilton’s driving style amid F1 2026 struggle
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc explained why he did not try to copy Lewis Hamilton's driving style when the Ferrari SF-26 was difficult to handle, choosing instead to adapt the car to his own natural style, which led to a breakthrough at Silverstone and victory in the British Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯与阿斯顿马丁参加年度慈善足球赛
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿马丁与梅赛德斯F1车队的工作人员在年度慈善足球赛中交锋，为两家慈善机构筹款。梅赛德斯男子队3-1获胜，阿斯顿马丁女子队2-1获胜。
items.titleEn: Mercedes and Aston Martin go head-to-head in charity football match: Here are the results
items.summaryEn: Staff from the Aston Martin and Mercedes Formula 1 teams went head-to-head in their annual charity football match to raise funds for two charities. Mercedes won the men's match 3-1 and Aston Martin won the women's match 2-1.

items.titleZh: 红牛承认维斯塔潘赛车神秘问题要到2027年才能完全解决
items.summaryZh: 红牛承认维斯塔潘多次抱怨的赛车在比赛周末中性能退化的问题无法在本赛季彻底解决，要到2027年才能完全修复。
items.titleEn: Red Bull admits Max Verstappen's mysterious car issue cannot be fully fixed until 2027
items.summaryEn: Red Bull has admitted that the mysterious car degradation issue repeatedly complained about by Max Verstappen cannot be fully fixed with this year's car and will only be completely resolved by 2027.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯对手在2026赛季F1中犯下的重大错误
items.summaryZh: 据Ben Anderson报道，安东内利的竞争对手们几乎已放弃争夺2026年F1年度冠军。报道指出，其他车队的失误让Antonelli和梅赛德斯的日子变得更加轻松。
items.titleEn: What Mercedes' rivals got so badly wrong in F1 2026
items.summaryEn: According to Ben Anderson, Kimi Antonelli's rivals have all but conceded the 2026 Formula 1 title race. The report notes that mistakes by other teams have made things easier for Antonelli and Mercedes.

items.titleZh: 罗斯伯格：安东内利与自己的心理较量将决定F1总冠军归属
items.summaryZh: 前F1世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格认为，基米·安东内利在本赛季总冠军争夺收官阶段面临的最大障碍是他自己。
items.titleEn: Kimi Antonelli versus his mind will decide 2026 Formula 1 title race, says Nico Rosberg ahead of Azerbaijan Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: Former F1 world champion Nico Rosberg believes that Kimi Antonelli's biggest obstacle in the closing stages of this season's title fight is himself.

items.titleZh: 克雷格·斯莱特解析阿塞拜疆大奖赛为何在周六举行
items.summaryZh: 天空体育记者克雷格·斯莱特解析阿塞拜疆大奖赛，解释了比赛为何安排在周六举行，期间还模仿了歌手克雷格·大卫。诺里斯在阿塞拜疆大奖赛多车相撞中退赛。
items.summaryEn: Sky Sports reporter Craig Slater breaks down the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, explaining why the race takes place on a Saturday, while doing his best Craig David impression. Norris crashed out of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix in a multi-car incident.

items.titleZh: 施泰纳看好诺里斯2026赛季超越拉塞尔升至第二
items.summaryZh: Guenther Steiner表示看好诺里斯在2026年F1车手积分榜上超越拉塞尔升至第二位。在马德里赛道赛道举行的首届西班牙大奖赛后，Norris以186分位列车手积分榜第四，Russell以211分排名第二，其队友安东内利以292分领跑。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris predicted to overtake George Russell in 2026 F1 standings
items.summaryEn: Guenther Steiner has backed Lando Norris to overtake George Russell for second place in the 2026 Formula 1 drivers' championship. Following the inaugural Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring circuit, Norris sits fourth with 186 points, while Russell is second with 211 and his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli leads with 292.

items.titleZh: 库特哈德警告：2027年布局不变重返马德林将是“愚蠢之举”
items.summaryZh: 大卫·库特哈德批评马德林赛道首届比赛超车机会寥寥，警告F1组织者若2027年不改变赛道布局便重返该赛道将是“愚蠢之举”。
items.titleEn: David Coulthard warns unchanged Madring return in 2027 would be "stupidity"
items.summaryEn: David Coulthard criticised the lack of overtaking at the inaugural Madring race and warned Formula 1 organisers that returning in 2027 without changing the layout would be "stupidity".

items.titleZh: 维特尔：F1须将“我们所热爱的事物”与可持续未来相结合
items.summaryZh: 四届世界冠军塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔认为，F1拥有将可持续发展目标与精彩的赛道表现相结合的技术。
items.titleEn: Sebastian Vettel: F1 must combine “things we love” with sustainable future
items.summaryEn: Four-time world champion Sebastian Vettel believes Formula 1 has the technology to pair its sustainability goals with an exciting on-track product.

items.titleZh: 施泰纳将马德里赛道争议与拉斯维加斯首秀相提并论，并发出2027年警告
items.summaryZh: 前哈斯F1车队领队京特·施泰纳表示，马德里马德里赛道赛道的西班牙大奖赛组织方必须紧急修改赛道布局，以应对2027年赛事。他将此次争议与拉斯维加斯大奖赛首秀时的情况相比较，并警告不能出现第二个像今年这样的年份。
items.titleEn: Guenther Steiner compares Madring backlash to Las Vegas debut with 2027 warning
items.summaryEn: Former Haas F1 team principal Guenther Steiner has warned that the organisers of the Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring circuit must urgently change the track's layout for 2027. He compared the backlash to the Las Vegas Grand Prix's debut and said there cannot be a second year like this one.

items.titleZh: 前工程师呼吁F1引入"增强型"仲裁小组以加快判罚
items.summaryZh: 前法拉利和威廉姆斯车队比赛工程师Rob Smedley提议，F1应引入一个"增强型"仲裁小组，以加快比赛中的判罚决定，避免简单事件在比赛结束后仍悬而未决。
items.titleEn: Former engineer urges F1 to introduce "augmented" stewarding group to speed up decisions
items.summaryEn: Former Ferrari and Williams race engineer Rob Smedley has proposed that Formula 1 introduce an "augmented" stewarding group to speed up in-race decisions and prevent straightforward incidents from dragging on beyond the chequered flag.

items.titleZh: 库特哈德呼吁FIA加快安全车决策速度
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手大卫·库特哈德认为，FIA在F1比赛中出动安全车时需加快决策流程。他指出，在西班牙大奖赛后，这方面显然仍有改进空间。
items.titleEn: David Coulthard urges FIA to speed up safety car decisions
items.summaryEn: Former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard believes the FIA needs to speed up its decision-making process when deploying the safety car in F1 races. He pointed out that after the Spanish Grand Prix, there is clearly still room for improvement in this area.

items.titleZh: 法拉利为何落后，以及接下来的计划
items.summaryZh: 法拉利在2026赛季开局良好，但下半赛季表现下滑，自7月斯帕站后未再登上领奖台。SF-26并非突然失去竞争力，而是对手尤其是迈凯伦的研发速度不断推高标杆，法拉利未能跟上，并推迟了自身升级计划的重要部分。
items.titleEn: Why Ferrari has fallen back - and what it plans to do
items.summaryEn: Ferrari started the 2026 season well but has seen a negative trend in the second half, failing to reach the podium since Spa in July. The SF-26 has not suddenly become uncompetitive, but rivals' development rate, especially McLaren's, has progressively raised the benchmark and Ferrari has not kept up, having postponed a major part of its own upgrade plan.

items.titleZh: 库特哈德赞扬拉塞尔坦承安东内利表现更佳
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手大卫·库特哈德赞扬乔治·拉塞尔公开承认梅赛德斯队友、当前积分榜领先者基米·安东内利表现更佳。安东内利在新马德里赛道举行的首届西班牙大奖赛上赢得本赛季第八场胜利，将积分榜领先优势扩大至81分，拉塞尔位居第二。
items.titleEn: George Russell praised for honest admission about Kimi Antonelli's F1 form
items.summaryEn: Former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard has praised George Russell for publicly admitting that his Mercedes team-mate and current championship leader Kimi Antonelli is doing a better job. Antonelli secured his eighth victory of the season at the inaugural Spanish Grand Prix at the new Madring circuit, extending his lead in the standings to 81 points over Russell, who sits second.

items.titleZh: 林德布拉德YouTube挑战中险些翻车世界最短菲亚特Panda
items.summaryZh: 小红牛 F1新秀阿尔维德·林德布拉德利用休息时间，在意大利汽车改装频道Carmagheddon的YouTube视频中测试了世界上最短的菲亚特Panda，期间险些将这辆吉尼斯世界纪录保持车辆开翻，但最终成功控制住了局面。
items.titleEn: Arvid Lindblad nearly flips world's shortest Fiat Panda in bizarre YouTube challenge
items.summaryEn: Racing Bulls F1 rookie Arvid Lindblad used some of his time off to test the world's shortest Fiat Panda in a YouTube video by Italian car modification channel Carmagheddon, nearly rolling the Guinness World Record-holding vehicle but managing to save it.

items.titleZh: 罗斯伯格称威廉姆斯2026年表现"令人震惊"，沃尔斯面临"艰难时刻"
items.summaryZh: 2016年F1世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格将威廉姆斯2026年的表现称为"令人震惊"，并认为车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯面临重大挑战，需要将这支格罗夫车队带回应有的位置。威廉姆斯进入2026赛季时已处于不利局面，此前错过了1月在巴塞罗那的私人测试，并在抵达巴林季前测试时赛车超重。
items.titleEn: James Vowles faces "tough moment" as Nico Rosberg calls Williams woes "a shocker"
items.summaryEn: 2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg has branded Williams's 2026 performance a "shocker" and argued that team principal James Vowles faces a major challenge to bring the Grove outfit back to where it needs to be. Williams entered the 2026 season already on the back foot, having missed the private testing in Barcelona in January and arrived at pre-season testing in Bahrain with an overweight car.

items.titleZh: 谁真正拥有每支F1车队？
items.summaryZh: 文章探讨了F1车队估值飙升背景下各车队的实际所有权结构，指出如今所有权形式远比过去复杂，并以阿斯顿·马丁、法拉利和红牛为例进行了分析。
items.titleEn: Who actually owns each F1 team?
items.summaryEn: The article examines the actual ownership structures of each F1 team amid soaring valuations, noting that ownership is far more complex than in the past, and analyzes Aston Martin, Ferrari, and Red Bull as examples.

items.titleZh: Gary Anderson：F1应做出的四项事故规则修改
items.summaryZh: 前F1技术总监Gary Anderson针对F1处理事故的方式提出四项规则修改建议，包括VSC期间车手必须至少通过起终点线一次、排位赛红旗只从起终点线到事故现场出示、造成红旗的车手应被取消最快圈速，以及比赛红旗期间不允许更换轮胎配方。
items.summaryEn: Former F1 technical director Gary Anderson has proposed four rule changes for how F1 handles incidents, including requiring drivers to pass the start-finish line at least once during a VSC, throwing the red flag only from the start-finish line to the scene of the incident in qualifying, stripping the fastest lap from a driver who causes a red flag, and not allowing tyre compound changes during a race red flag.

items.titleZh: 驾驶风格能解释拉塞尔和皮亚斯特里2026年的困境吗？
items.summaryZh: Mark Hughes撰文分析，拉塞尔认为自己的驾驶风格与2026年赛车和轮胎不匹配，但文章指出维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔的风格各不相同，拉塞尔将两人归为同类并不成立。
items.titleEn: Do driving styles really explain these drivers' 2026 F1 struggles?
items.summaryEn: Mark Hughes examines whether driving style explains the struggles of George Russell and Oscar Piastri in 2026, noting that Russell's theory grouping himself with Verstappen and Leclerc breaks down because their styles are distinct.

items.titleZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛周六举行：赛程与观看指南
items.summaryZh: F1重返巴库城市赛道，阿塞拜疆大奖赛因该国纪念日改在周六（9月26日）举行，排位赛周五、练习赛周四进行。
items.titleEn: Azerbaijan GP 2026: Saturday race, dates, schedule, Baku weather, UK start time and how to watch or stream F1 live on Sky Sports
items.summaryEn: F1 returns to the Baku City Circuit for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, which is held on Saturday, September 26 due to the country's Remembrance Day, with qualifying on Friday and practice on Thursday.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿否认要求法拉利人事变动
items.summaryZh: 汉密尔顿在社交媒体上否认了意大利媒体关于他要求法拉利进行人事变动的报道，表示从未要求替换车队任何人。
items.titleEn: Lewis Hamilton responds to reports he has asked for Ferrari personnel changes ahead of Azerbaijan Grand Prix

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿坚决否认要求更换法拉利员工
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在社交媒体上坚决否认他曾要求法拉利更换车队员工，回应了意大利媒体的相关报道。
items.titleEn: Hamilton firmly denies asking for Ferrari staff to be replaced
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton has firmly denied on social media that he ever asked for anyone on his Ferrari team to be replaced, responding to reports in the Italian media.

items.titleZh: 安德森：F1超车难题遍布各赛道，非马德里独有
items.summaryZh: 前F1工程师加里·安德森表示，马德里赛道（马德里赛道）首站基本不存在真正的竞争性超车，而这一问题在当前几乎所有F1赛道上都普遍存在。
items.titleEn: Gary Anderson: F1's overtaking problem is bigger than one circuit
items.summaryEn: Former F1 engineer Gary Andersen says competitive overtaking was basically absent at the Madring's first race, and argues the problem is common to most, if not all, current F1 circuits.

items.titleZh: 阿尔派任命前梅赛德斯F1技术主管Mike Elliott为首席技术官
items.summaryZh: 前梅赛德斯F1技术负责人Mike Elliott在离开围场三年后回归，出任阿尔派新任首席技术官。
items.titleEn: Alpine hires ex-Mercedes F1 tech chief
items.summaryEn: Former Mercedes Formula 1 technical boss Mike Elliott will return to the paddock after a three-year absence as Alpine's new chief technical officer.

items.titleZh: 墨尔本排除自身作为2027年F1揭幕战候选的可能性
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚大奖赛明确表示不会成为2027年F1赛季揭幕战的备选方案，并已完全锁定临时赛历上4月初的日期。
items.titleEn: Melbourne rules itself out of 2027 F1 opener contention
items.summaryEn: The Australian Grand Prix has made clear it will not be a standby option for Formula 1's 2027 season-opener and is fully committed to its early April date on the provisional calendar.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯：摩纳哥引入冲刺赛将带来更大挑战
items.summaryZh: 世界冠军兰多·诺里斯认为，2027年摩纳哥大奖赛首次引入冲刺赛制后，车手将面临比往常更大的挑战，因为只有一节练习赛就要直接进入排位赛。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris: McLaren driver reacts to Monaco Sprint news for 2027 season after Formula 1 calendar surprise
items.summaryEn: World champion Lando Norris believes Formula 1 drivers will face a greater challenge at next year's Monaco Grand Prix than normal due to the addition of the Sprint format, as only one practice session will precede qualifying.

items.titleZh: 2017新加坡大奖赛：维斯塔潘与法拉利双雄首弯相撞
items.summaryZh: 2017年新加坡大奖赛发车阶段，红牛车手马克斯·维斯塔潘与法拉利车手塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔、基米·莱科宁发生碰撞，成为F1历史上最具戏剧性的发车之一。
items.titleEn: Most dramatic first corner crash ever? Relive EPIC 2017 Singapore GP start!
items.summaryEn: At the start of the 2017 Singapore Grand Prix, Red Bull's Max Verstappen collided with the Ferrari pair of Sebastian Vettel and Kimi Raikkonen in one of the most dramatic first corners in F1 history.

items.titleZh: 红牛：哈贾尔康复进展正常，是否出战阿塞拜疆大奖赛待评估
items.summaryZh: 红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯表示，车队将继续把伊萨克·哈贾尔的康复放在首位，不会急于让他伤愈复出；车队计划先进行评估，再决定他是否参加下周的阿塞拜疆大奖赛。
items.titleEn: Isack Hadjar: Red Bull driver's injury recovery going to plan as team provide update on next steps ahead of Azerbaijan GP decision
items.summaryEn: Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies says the team will continue to prioritise Isack Hadjar's recovery over rushing his return from injury, with evaluations planned before a decision on whether he races at next week's Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 奥康称自己是自由车手，对2027年哈斯前景存疑
items.summaryZh: 奥康表示自己是自由车手，这让他对2027年继续效力哈斯的未来产生了很大疑问。
items.titleEn: Ex-Red Bull design chief among three key Cadillac hires
items.summaryEn: Esteban Ocon says he is a free agent, which has raised major questions about his future with Haas beyond 2027.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘在红牛活动中从队尾击败100名卡丁车手
items.summaryZh: 在银石赛道举行的红牛Max vs 100活动中，维斯塔潘从队尾发车，最终击败了100名名人卡丁车手。
items.titleEn: Verstappen beats 100 karters (from the back) in Red Bull event
items.summaryEn: In Red Bull's Max vs 100 event at Silverstone, Max Verstappen started from the back of the grid and beat 100 celebrity karters.

items.titleZh: 角田裕毅坦言红牛F1生涯令他精疲力竭
items.summaryZh: 角田裕毅回顾在红牛与维斯塔潘搭档的2025赛季，坦言自己感到精疲力竭、享受不到生活，并最终失去席位，但这段经历让他成为更好的车手。
items.titleEn: “I’m not enjoying life” – How Yuki Tsunoda’s Red Bull F1 stint “exhausted” him
items.summaryEn: Yuki Tsunoda reflected on his 2025 season alongside Max Verstappen at Red Bull, admitting he felt exhausted and was not enjoying life, and although he ultimately lost his seat, he believes the hardship made him a better driver.

items.titleZh: 凯迪拉克西班牙正赛速度是否快过威廉姆斯？
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克在西班牙大奖赛正赛速度令人鼓舞，佩雷斯退赛前与阿尔本节奏相当，但博塔斯对赛车可靠性和性能仍感担忧。
items.titleEn: Was Cadillac “faster” than Williams in Madring F1 race?
items.summaryEn: Cadillac showed encouraging race pace in the Spanish Grand Prix, with Sergio Perez matching Alexander Albon's pace before retiring, while Valtteri Bottas remained concerned about reliability and performance.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘将在银石挑战100名卡丁车手
items.summaryZh: F1世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘于9月16日（周三）在银石参加由红牛举办的“Max vs 100”挑战，与100名卡丁车手同场竞技，对手包括运动员、名人和内容创作者等。
items.titleEn: How to watch Max vs 100
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 world champion Max Verstappen is taking on a new challenge called 'Max vs 100' at Silverstone on Wednesday 16 September, racing against 100 go-karters including athletes, celebrities and content creators.

items.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯在马德里如何把握运气
items.summaryZh: 安东内利赢得F1西班牙大奖赛，兰斯·斯特罗尔退赛引发的虚拟安全车出现在完美时机，改变了原本看似将由诺里斯获胜的比赛走势。VSC部署时诺里斯已驶过维修区入口，而安东内利在最后一刻进入维修区完成进站，取得虚拟领先。
items.titleEn: How Kimi Antonelli and Mercedes made their own luck in Madrid
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli won the F1 Spanish Grand Prix after a virtual safety car triggered by Lance Stroll's retirement came at the perfect moment, changing the course of a race that had seemed destined for Lando Norris. Norris had already passed the pitlane entry when the VSC was deployed, while Antonelli managed to enter the pitlane at the last second, complete his stop and take the virtual lead.

items.titleZh: 解析：2027年F1摩纳哥站为何设立冲刺赛
items.summaryZh: 天空体育的克雷格·斯莱特解释了摩纳哥为何被选为2027年F1赛季冲刺赛的举办地。
items.titleEn: Formula 1: Why is there a Monaco Sprint in 2027?
items.summaryEn: Sky Sports' Craig Slater explains why Monaco has been chosen as a Sprint venue for the 2027 F1 season.

items.titleZh: 摩纳哥F1冲刺赛：好主意还是疯狂之举？记者各抒己见
items.summaryZh: F1公布2027年24站赛历时宣布摩纳哥大奖赛将采用冲刺赛制，Motorsport.com的记者们就这一安排展开讨论，有人认为这破坏了摩纳哥周末的传统节奏，也有人主张F1应借此机会对冲刺赛制进行更大胆的改革。
items.titleEn: Is a Monaco F1 sprint a good idea or just mad? Our writers have their say
items.summaryEn: As Formula 1 announced its 24-race 2027 calendar, the most intriguing novelty is the Monaco Grand Prix receiving a sprint format, and Motorsport.com's writers weigh up whether that is a good idea or just bonkers. Some argue it disrupts the DNA of the Monaco weekend, while others believe F1 could be braver with its sprint format.

items.titleZh: 2027年F1赛历公布：摩纳哥将首次举办冲刺赛
items.summaryZh: F1公布2027年赛历，全年仍为创纪录的24个比赛周末，冲刺赛场次增至10场，摩纳哥首次成为冲刺赛举办地。
items.titleEn: F1 2027 calendar: Monaco staging one of 10 Sprints and other talking points from race schedule reveal for next season
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 has released its 2027 calendar, which again features a record-equalling 24 race weekends, with the number of Sprint events increasing to 10 and Monaco hosting a Sprint for the first time.

items.titleZh: 哈斯对2027年F1预算接近上限抱有信心，正洽谈新合作伙伴
items.summaryZh: 哈斯车队领队小松礼雄表示，车队在寻找新赞助方面正取得"积极"进展，希望推动年度预算逐步接近预算上限。
items.titleEn: Haas confident of getting 2027 F1 budget closer to cap with new partner talks
items.summaryEn: Haas team principal Ayao Komatsu says the team is making "positive" progress in its search for new sponsorship, as the American Formula 1 team seeks to push its yearly budget closer to the cap.

items.titleZh: F1赛程避开勒芒冲突，诺里斯或维斯塔潘能否出战2027年勒芒？
items.summaryZh: 2027年F1赛历公布，24站赛程为6月12日至13日的勒芒24小时耐力赛留出空档，前后两站为摩纳哥和葡萄牙，无直接冲突。但勒芒测试日与摩纳哥大奖赛同周末，F1车手若想参赛仍需克服多项障碍。
items.titleEn: F1 clash avoided but can Lando Norris or Max Verstappen race at Le Mans 2027?
items.summaryEn: The 2027 Formula 1 calendar has been announced with 24 rounds, leaving a comfortable one-week gap for the Le Mans 24 Hours on the weekend of 12-13 June, with Monaco and Portugal as the surrounding races. However, the Le Mans test day clashes with the Monaco Grand Prix, meaning F1 drivers still face several hurdles if they want to race at Le Mans.

items.titleZh: 2027年F1赛历公布：冲刺赛扩容引发争议
items.summaryZh: The 比赛团队评论F1公布的2027年赛历，指出其中包含令人意外的选择，尤其针对冲刺赛场次扩大至10场以及部分举办地点的选择。
items.titleEn: Sacrilege? Our verdict on 2027 F1 calendar + sprint expansion
items.summaryEn: The Race team comments on Formula 1's 2027 calendar announcement, pointing out surprising choices, especially the expansion to 10 sprint races and the selection of some sprint-hosting venues.

items.titleZh: F1 2027年赛历：摩纳哥首办冲刺赛，中东揭幕
items.summaryZh: F1公布改版后的2027年赛历，出人意料地加入摩纳哥冲刺赛，并坚持原计划由巴林和沙特阿拉伯在中东开启新赛季。
items.titleEn: Monaco sprint and season opener Plan B - F1's 2027 calendar
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 has published its revamped 2027 calendar, which surprisingly includes a sprint race in Monaco, while sticking with its original plan to start the season in the Middle East with Bahrain and Saudi Arabia.

items.titleZh: F1公布2027年赛历：冲刺赛增至10站，巴林揭幕
items.summaryZh: F1公布2027年赛历，全年仍为24站，冲刺赛周末从六站增加到10站，赛季在巴林揭幕，葡萄牙和土耳其回归。
items.titleEn: F1 2027 calendar announced with Bahrain to host season-opener and increase in Sprint weekends in 24-race schedule
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 has announced its 2027 calendar, which keeps 24 rounds, increases Sprint weekends from six to 10, opens the season in Bahrain, and sees Portugal and Turkey return.

items.titleZh: F1公布2027赛季赛历：24站比赛，10个冲刺赛周末
items.summaryZh: F1公布了2027赛季24站赛历，冲刺赛周末增至10个，摩纳哥首次举办冲刺赛。赛季3月14日在巴林揭幕，收官战为阿布扎比。
items.titleEn: F1 announces 2027 calendar - with Monaco among 10 sprint races
items.summaryEn: F1 has unveiled its 24-race calendar for the 2027 season, increasing the number of sprint weekends to 10, with Monaco hosting a sprint race for the first time. The season starts in Bahrain on 14 March and finishes in Abu Dhabi.

items.titleZh: 维特尔：若安东内利打破最年轻世界冠军纪录，我会非常高兴
items.summaryZh: 塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔表示，如果基米·安东内利打破他保持的F1最年轻世界冠军纪录，他会“非常高兴”。安东内利目前越来越有可能在20岁时赢得今年年度冠军，他在西班牙大奖赛的胜利将领先主要挑战者、梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔的优势扩大到81分。
items.titleEn: Sebastian Vettel: “I’d be very happy” for Kimi Antonelli to beat me as F1’s youngest champion
items.summaryEn: Sebastian Vettel says he would be "very happy" for Kimi Antonelli to break his record as Formula 1's youngest world champion. Antonelli is increasingly likely to win this year's title at just 20 years of age, with his Spanish Grand Prix victory boosting his advantage over main challenger and Mercedes team-mate George Russell to 81 points.

items.titleZh: F1虚拟安全车规则争议：西班牙站诺里斯事件引发讨论
items.summaryZh: 由于兰多·诺里斯在西班牙大奖赛遭遇的虚拟安全车时机问题，F1虚拟安全车规则预计将被列入体育咨询委员会下次会议议程。
items.titleEn: F1's huge dilemma over VSC lottery rule
items.summaryEn: Formula 1's virtual safety car rules are expected to be added to the agenda of the next Sporting Advisory Committee meeting after Lando Norris's experience at the Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 阿隆索F1未来悬而未决：留队消息"不会很快"公布
items.summaryZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索表示，关于他是否继续留在阿斯顿·马丁的消息"不会很快"公布，其F1未来仍不明朗。他对2026年新规和阿斯顿·马丁-本田赛车表现感到失望，本赛季仅两次得分。
items.titleEn: Fernando Alonso: What's the latest on Aston Martin driver's future as he weighs up retirement or new contract to stay in F1 in 2027?
items.summaryEn: Fernando Alonso has said news about whether he will remain at Aston Martin will "not come soon", leaving his F1 future uncertain. He has been frustrated with F1's 2026 regulations and the performance of his Aston Martin-Honda car, having scored points just twice this season.

items.titleZh: 斯特拉：迈凯伦需帮助皮亚斯特里摆脱对2026款F1赛车的“思考式驾驶”
items.summaryZh: 迈凯伦车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉认为，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里目前落后于兰多·诺里斯，原因在于这位澳大利亚车手仍在“一边思考一边驾驶”2026款F1赛车。斯特拉表示，迈凯伦将帮助皮亚斯特里与MCL40赛车找到更自然的平衡。
items.titleEn: Andrea Stella: McLaren must help Oscar Piastri stop "thinking" about how to drive '26 F1 car
items.summaryEn: McLaren team principal Andrea Stella believes Oscar Piastri's current deficit to Lando Norris is down to the Australian still "thinking and driving" with the 2026 Formula 1 machinery. Stella says McLaren will support Piastri in helping to find a more natural balance with its MCL40 F1 car.

items.titleZh: 法拉利暂不将重心转向2027年赛车，将继续研发SF-26
items.summaryZh: 法拉利领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔表示，尽管夺冠希望日渐渺茫，车队仍将继续研发SF-26赛车，暂不转向2027年项目。
items.titleEn: Why Ferrari won't switch focus to 2027 F1 car yet
items.summaryEn: Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur says the team will keep developing its SF-26 F1 car despite diminishing title chances, rather than switching focus to the 2027 car yet.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦：马德里赛道超车太难，诺里斯错失西班牙大奖赛胜利
items.summaryZh: 迈凯伦领队安德烈亚·斯特拉表示，马德里街道赛道超车过于困难，导致兰多·诺里斯无法赢得西班牙大奖赛。诺里斯夺得杆位并在前12圈拉开6秒差距，但虚拟安全车出动时他距离太远无法进站，此后虽追近基米·安东内利和马克斯·维斯塔潘，却始终无法完成超越。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris lost Madring F1 win because of impossible overtaking – McLaren
items.summaryEn: McLaren team principal Andrea Stella said overtaking was too difficult at the Madring for Lando Norris to win the Spanish Grand Prix. Norris took pole and pulled six seconds clear in the first 12 laps, but was too far ahead to pit under the virtual safety car and, despite closing on Kimi Antonelli and Max Verstappen, was never able to make a move.

items.titleZh: 这一“修复”方案本无法拯救F1西班牙大奖赛
items.summaryZh: 针对西班牙大奖赛观感平淡的问题，外界多归咎于马德里赛道缺乏超车机会，但乔恩·诺布尔指出战术变化不足也是被忽视的因素，而所谓的“修复”方案本无法拯救这场比赛。
items.titleEn: This 'fix' wouldn't have saved F1's Spanish GP
items.summaryEn: The lack of overtaking at the Madring circuit has been blamed for the Spanish Grand Prix's poor spectacle, but another overlooked factor was the lack of strategic variation, meaning track changes alone would not have saved the race.

items.titleZh: 罗斯伯格：拉塞尔或正以“疯狂动力”应对安东内利的挑战
items.summaryZh: 尼科·罗斯伯格认为，乔治·拉塞尔目前可能正被一种类似当年他试图扭转对刘易斯·汉密尔顿连败局面时的“疯狂动力”所驱动，以在与基米·安东内利的竞争中扭转局势。
items.titleEn: George Russell: Mercedes driver's losses to Kimi Antonelli will feel 'painful' says Nico Rosberg as driver backed for breakthrough
items.summaryEn: Nico Rosberg believes George Russell is likely being driven by a similar "insane motivation" to turn the tables on Kimi Antonelli as he once was to get the better of Lewis Hamilton after recurring defeats.

items.titleZh: F1马德里首秀缺乏超车，主办方第二年需改进的五点
items.summaryZh: 马德里赛道承办的F1首秀场外组织成功，但比赛缺乏超车动作引发批评。文章列出了主办方在第二年可以改进该赛事的五个方面。
items.titleEn: Five ways F1 can fix the Madring for next year's Spanish GP
items.summaryEn: Formula 1's long-awaited return to Madrid left fans wanting due to a lack of action, although the Madring venue itself staged a respectable event. The article outlines five ways organisers could improve the race for its second year.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯解释拉塞尔西班牙站VSC下进站原因
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯副领队布拉德利·洛德解释了乔治·拉塞尔在F1西班牙大奖赛中为何在虚拟安全车（VSC）下进站，尽管他是以硬胎起步。拉塞尔是顶级车队中唯一没有坚持一停策略的车手，这主要与VSC介入的时机有关。
items.titleEn: Mercedes explains why George Russell pitted under VSC at Madring
items.summaryEn: Mercedes deputy team principal Bradley Lord has explained why George Russell pitted under the virtual safety car despite starting on hard tyres in Formula 1's Spanish Grand Prix. Russell was the only driver from the top teams not to stick to a one-stop, which was largely down to the timing of the VSC intervention.

items.titleZh: 维特尔领衔车王争霸赛新西兰首站
items.summaryZh: 车王争霸赛公布2027年新西兰首站首批四位车手，四届F1世界冠军维特尔领衔，赛事将于2027年1月9日至10日在惠灵顿Hnry Stadium举行。
items.titleEn: F1 world champion among drivers for Race Of Champions’ first New Zealand event
items.summaryEn: The Race Of Champions has announced the first four drivers for its inaugural New Zealand event, led by four-time Formula 1 world champion Sebastian Vettel, taking place at Wellington's Hnry Stadium on 9-10 January 2027.

items.titleZh: 奥迪首位F1青训车手斯莱特2027年加盟Invicta征战F2
items.summaryZh: 奥迪首位F1青训车手Freddie Slater将于2027年加入F2卫冕冠军车队Invicta，征战Formula 2。
items.titleEn: Audi's shrewd choice of F2 team for its first F1 junior
items.summaryEn: Audi's first Formula 1 junior driver Freddie Slater will join defending champion team Invicta in Formula 2 in 2027.

items.titleZh: 奥迪青训车手斯莱特2027赛季随Invicta升入F2
items.summaryZh: F3年度亚军、奥迪F1青训车手弗雷迪·斯莱特将于2027年随Invicta 比赛升入F2。这位2024年意大利F4和2025年欧洲区域方程式冠军于2026年被奥迪签下，以领衔其新设立的车手发展计划，同时他随Trident车队征战F3。
items.titleEn: Audi F1 junior Freddie Slater signs F2 deal for 2027 season
items.summaryEn: Formula 3 runner-up and Audi Formula 1 junior Freddie Slater will step up to Formula 2 with Invicta Racing in 2027. The 2024 Italian F4 and 2025 Formula Regional European champion was signed by Audi in 2026 to spearhead its new Driver Development Programme, while he raced in F3 with Trident.

items.titleZh: 红牛称哈贾尔康复进展正常
items.summaryZh: 红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯表示，伊萨克·哈贾尔的伤病恢复符合预期，尽管这位法国车手已缺席最近三场F1大奖赛。哈贾尔在夏休期训练中手腕受伤，此后由利亚姆·劳森顶替其席位，储备车手角田裕毅则在小红牛车队临时出战。
items.titleEn: Red Bull insists “there is nothing wrong” with Isack Hadjar's recovery
items.summaryEn: Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies says Isack Hadjar's recovery from injury is on target, despite the Frenchman having missed the last three Formula 1 grands prix. Hadjar injured his wrist in training during the summer break and has since been replaced by Liam Lawson, with reserve driver Yuki Tsunoda standing in at Racing Bulls.

items.titleZh: Hinchcliffe：安东内利西班牙大奖赛夺冠仍会感到"刺痛"
items.summaryZh: 前IndyCar系列赛车手、F1 TV评论员James Hinchcliffe表示，梅赛德斯车手、当前积分榜领跑者安东内利在西班牙大奖赛夺冠后仍会感到"刺痛"，因为他知道迈凯伦车手诺里斯拥有更快的赛车。Antonelli在马德里赛道赛道举行的首届比赛中赢得2026赛季F1个人第八场胜利，进一步扩大了自己的领先优势。
items.titleEn: Kimi Antonelli's Spanish GP win will still "sting", says James Hinchcliffe
items.summaryEn: Former IndyCar Series driver and F1 TV analyst James Hinchcliffe said Mercedes driver and current championship leader Kimi Antonelli will still feel a "sting" after his Spanish Grand Prix victory because he knows McLaren's Lando Norris had the faster car. Antonelli secured his eighth win of the 2026 Formula 1 season at the inaugural race at the Madring circuit, extending his lead in the standings.

items.titleZh: 科拉平托借鉴加斯利蒙扎杆位经验，在西班牙大奖赛取得突破
items.summaryZh: 科拉平托表示，研究队友加斯利在蒙扎的排位赛表现帮助他在西班牙大奖赛上取得进步，他进入第三节排位赛并最终获得第七名。此前他在蒙扎排位第八，而加斯利则出人意料地夺得杆位。
items.titleEn: What Colapinto learned from Gasly's Monza pole to make his Madrid breakthrough
items.summaryEn: Franco Colapinto says studying Pierre Gasly's qualifying performance at Monza helped him make progress at the Spanish Grand Prix, where he reached Q3 and finished seventh. He had qualified eighth at Monza while his Alpine team-mate Gasly took a surprise pole position.

items.titleZh: 沃尔夫警告安东内利：领先优势仍可能被"黑天鹅事件"颠覆
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫表示，尽管基米·安东内利在西班牙大奖赛夺冠后以81分领跑积分榜，但他仍需警惕可能出现的意外"黑天鹅事件"，这些事件有可能使其冠军争夺战脱轨。
items.titleEn: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff issues Formula 1 title race caution despite Kimi Antonelli's big points lead
items.summaryEn: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff says Kimi Antonelli must remain wary of unexpected "black swan events" that could derail his championship bid, despite holding an 81-point lead after his Spanish Grand Prix victory.

items.titleZh: 运气不佳？诺里斯西班牙大奖赛失利原因分析
items.summaryZh: Jon Noble分析指出，兰多·诺里斯在西班牙大奖赛因虚拟安全车的时机而错失胜利，问题在于这是否纯属注定，还是迈凯伦本可挽救。就连冠军安东内利也承认诺里斯运气极差。
items.titleEn: Just bad luck? What really robbed Norris of Spanish GP win
items.summaryEn: In the Spanish Grand Prix, Lando Norris lost a likely victory due to the unlucky timing of a virtual safety car (VSC), ultimately finishing third. McLaren will analyze whether it could have handled the situation better.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯完成迈凯伦勒芒超级跑车首次完整测试
items.summaryZh: 卫冕F1世界冠军兰多·诺里斯周一在波尔蒂芒完成了迈凯伦MCL-HY勒芒超级跑车的首次完整测试，共完成38圈、累计177公里。此次测试引发外界对他可能于明年首次出战勒芒的猜测。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris completes first full test in McLaren’s Le Mans Hypercar
items.summaryEn: Reigning Formula 1 champion Lando Norris completed his first full test in the McLaren MCL-HY Le Mans Hypercar at Portimao on Monday, running 38 laps and covering 177km. The test has sparked rumours about a potential Le Mans debut for the Briton next year.

items.titleZh: Max vs 100参赛名单公布：谁将与维斯塔潘同场竞速？
items.summaryZh: 9月16日星期三，100名卡丁车手将在银石赛道专门搭建的赛道上挑战四届F1世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘，参加“Max vs 100”活动。该活动将在Disney+直播，维斯塔潘需要在这条专为活动打造的赛道上逐一突破100名对手，而对手们的目标则是联手对抗他。目前，大部分参赛车手名单已经公布。
items.titleEn: Who is racing Max Verstappen in "Max vs 100"? Entry list revealed
items.summaryEn: On Wednesday, September 16, 100 karters will challenge four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen on a purpose-built circuit at Silverstone in the "Max vs 100" event. Streaming live on Disney+, Verstappen must fight through 100 opponents, who will work together to keep him behind them during the 30-lap challenge. The majority of the entry list has now been revealed.

items.titleZh: 2026年F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛为何安排在周六举行
items.summaryZh: 2026年F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛将于9月26日周六在巴库举行，而非通常的周日，原因是9月27日是阿塞拜疆纪念日，全国进入哀悼日。整个比赛周末因此提前一天，媒体日为周三，练习赛和排位赛分别在周四和周五，正赛在周六。
items.titleEn: Why is the F1 Azerbaijan GP not on Sunday in 2026?
items.summaryEn: The 2026 Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix will be held on Saturday 26 September in Baku instead of the usual Sunday, because 27 September is Azerbaijan Remembrance Day, a national day of mourning. The entire race weekend shifts one day earlier, with media day on Wednesday, practice and qualifying on Thursday and Friday, and the race on Saturday.

items.titleZh: 施泰纳批评诺里斯西班牙大奖赛后喝可口可乐行为"不专业"
items.summaryZh: 前哈斯车队领队京特·施泰纳批评兰多·诺里斯在西班牙大奖赛后的冷却室内喝可口可乐，称其行为不专业。
items.titleEn: Guenther Steiner criticises Lando Norris's Coca-Cola Spanish GP moment as 'unprofessional'
items.summaryEn: Former Haas team principal Guenther Steiner criticised Lando Norris for drinking Coca-Cola in the cooldown room after the Spanish Grand Prix, calling the behaviour unprofessional.

items.titleZh: F1不应因诺里斯马德里失利而仓促修改规则
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯在西班牙大奖赛因第14圈斯特罗尔退赛触发虚拟安全车的时机不巧而错失几乎到手的分站胜利，文章认为F1不应为此仓促修改规则。
items.titleEn: Why F1 should avoid knee-jerk rule changes after Lando Norris' Madrid heartbreak
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris lost an almost guaranteed win at the Spanish Grand Prix due to the unfortunate timing of a virtual safety car triggered by Lance Stroll's retirement on lap 14, and the article argues that F1 should not rush into rule changes because of it.

items.titleZh: F2巴库站增设额外正赛，赛程扩容引关注
items.summaryZh: F2宣布在巴库站举办“超大规模”比赛周末，增加一场正赛，决定在比赛周末开始前仅10天公布。此举时机异常，外界关注其是否与F1赛季收官阶段的不确定性有关。
items.titleEn: F2 bulks up Baku schedule with extra feature race – is this a clue for F1’s future?
items.summaryEn: Formula 2 has announced a "supersized" meeting for its next round in Baku, adding an extra feature race just 10 days before the race weekend. The unusual and late decision raises questions about whether it is linked to uncertainty over the end of the Formula 1 season.

items.titleZh: 罗斯伯格惊叹安东内利2026赛季表现出的"难以置信"成熟度
items.summaryZh: 2016年F1世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格表示，他对基米·安东内利在2026赛季展现出的成熟度感到惊讶。安东内利在西班牙大奖赛上赢得本赛季第八场胜利，进一步扩大车手积分榜领先优势，目前以81分领先排名第二的队友乔治·拉塞尔。
items.titleEn: Nico Rosberg stunned by Kimi Antonelli's "unbelievable" maturity in 2026 F1 title fight
items.summaryEn: 2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg says he has been astonished by Kimi Antonelli's maturity during the 2026 season. Antonelli extended his lead in the drivers' championship with his eighth win of the season at the Spanish Grand Prix, and now sits 81 points ahead of his team-mate George Russell, who is second in the standings.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦不怪罪F1赛事控制，西班牙大奖赛胜利因虚拟安全车错失
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯在西班牙大奖赛从杆位起步后原本有望获胜，但一次时机不佳的虚拟安全车让他错失争冠机会。迈凯伦表示不会因此责怪赛事控制。
items.titleEn: Why McLaren won’t blame F1 race control for lost Spanish GP victory
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris looked set to win the Spanish Grand Prix from pole position, but an ill-timed virtual safety car cost him a shot at victory. McLaren said it will not blame race control for the bad luck.

items.titleZh: 蒙托亚预计威廉姆斯将在阿塞拜疆大奖赛迎来"巨大进步"
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚预计，威廉姆斯车队将在即将到来的阿塞拜疆大奖赛上取得"巨大进步"，这支格罗夫车队正准备推出急需的升级套件。威廉姆斯在首届西班牙大奖赛的马德里环赛道经历了又一个艰难的周末，卡洛斯·塞恩斯的主场比赛以退赛告终，他的队友亚历克斯·阿尔本则完赛。
items.titleEn: Williams tipped for "huge step" forward at Azerbaijan GP with major upgrade
items.summaryEn: Former Formula 1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya expects Williams to take a "huge step" forward at the upcoming Azerbaijan Grand Prix as the Grove outfit prepares to introduce a much-needed upgrade package. Williams endured another difficult weekend at the inaugural Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring circuit, where Carlos Sainz's home race ended in retirement and his team-mate Alex Albon finished 15th.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔西班牙大奖赛后争冠希望被称"已无望"，被告知转向2027赛季
items.summaryZh: F1电视评论员、前IndyCar车手James Hinchcliffe认为，拉塞尔在西班牙大奖赛后争冠已"无望"，应把2026赛季剩余比赛当作2027赛季的提前准备。
items.titleEn: George Russell told to turn focus to 2027 as title bid branded "a write-off" after Spanish GP
items.summaryEn: Former IndyCar driver and F1 TV analyst James Hinchcliffe says George Russell's championship fight is a "write-off" after the Spanish Grand Prix, and that he should use the rest of the 2026 season as early preparation for 2027.

items.titleZh: 安东内利冠军希望：惊人数据支撑，最差表现也足以夺冠
items.summaryZh: 2026赛季F1在14场大奖赛后，安东内利领先拉塞尔 81分、汉密尔顿 101分、诺里斯 106分，其赛季最差的八场成绩也足以保住冠军领先。
items.titleEn: His worst races would be enough: The remarkable stats behind Kimi Antonelli’s title hopes
items.summaryEn: After 14 grands prix in the 2026 Formula 1 season, Kimi Antonelli leads George Russell by 81 points, Lewis Hamilton by 101 and Lando Norris by 106, and even his eight worst results of the season would be enough to preserve his championship lead.

items.titleZh: 2026赛季F1西班牙大奖赛后队友对决战绩更新
items.summaryZh: 2026赛季F1西班牙大奖赛后，全部11支车队的队友对决战绩更新，涵盖排位赛、冲刺赛和大奖赛的最新得分。
items.titleEn: F1 2026 team-mate head-to-heads after Azerbaijan GP
items.summaryEn: After the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix, the team-mate head-to-head scores for all 11 Formula 1 teams have been updated, covering the latest Qualifying, Sprint and Grand Prix results.

items.titleZh: 格罗斯让就争议性无根据言论向迈凯伦道歉
items.summaryZh: F1与Canal+评论员罗曼·格罗斯让公开向迈凯伦及扎克·布朗道歉，原因是他在马德里报道西班牙大奖赛期间误解了布朗的言论并发表尖锐批评。
items.titleEn: Romain Grosjean apologises to McLaren after controversial, unfounded comments
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 and Canal+ pundit Romain Grosjean publicly apologised to McLaren and Zak Brown after misunderstanding and sharply criticising remarks made by the McLaren team principal during the Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring.

items.titleZh: 西班牙大奖赛承诺因F1批评而修改马德里马德里赛道赛道
items.summaryZh: 马德里西班牙大奖赛主办方表示愿意调整马德里赛道赛道，以提升2027年的超车机会，并已收到国际汽联的建议。这条围绕马德里IFEMA展览中心、全长5.4公里的赛道上周末完成竞赛首秀，设施和驾驶挑战性获得好评，但超车机会匮乏导致比赛缺乏精彩场面。
items.titleEn: Spanish GP promises Madring track changes following F1 criticism
items.summaryEn: The organisers of the Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid say they are ready to modify the Madring circuit to boost overtaking for 2027, and have already received recommendations from the FIA. The 5.4km circuit around Madrid's IFEMA fairgrounds made its competition debut last weekend, earning praise for its facilities and driving challenge despite criticism over the lack of overtaking opportunities.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯批评虚拟安全车规则不公平 称其夺走马德里站胜利
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯表示F1应修改“不公平”的虚拟安全车规则，该规则在2026年西班牙大奖赛马德里赛道上夺走了他的胜利。
items.titleEn: Norris calls out 'unfair' VSC rules after lost Madrid win
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris says Formula 1 should change its "unfair" virtual safety car rules, which cost him victory at the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯在西班牙大奖赛失利后呼吁修改虚拟安全车规则
items.summaryZh: 诺里斯在西班牙大奖赛因虚拟安全车时机而将胜利让给安东内利，赛后他称这一时机“不公平”，并呼吁修改F1虚拟安全车规则。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris: McLaren driver calls for rule changes to Formula 1 Virtual Safety Car rules after losing out on win to Kimi Antonelli
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris lost victory to Kimi Antonelli at the Spanish Grand Prix due to the timing of the Virtual Safety Car, which he called "unfair," and he has called for changes to Formula 1's Virtual Safety Car rules.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿称2026年F1争冠已无望：安东内利势不可挡
items.summaryZh: 在安东内利赢得西班牙大奖赛后，刘易斯·汉密尔顿表示，今年争夺创纪录第八个F1世界冠军的希望似乎已经破灭，并称这位积分榜领跑者“势不可挡”。
items.titleEn: Lewis Hamilton says 'there's no stopping' Kimi Antonelli as Ferrari driver appears to give up 2026 F1 title bid
items.summaryEn: After Kimi Antonelli won the Spanish Grand Prix, Lewis Hamilton said his hopes of winning a record eighth F1 title this year appear to be over, calling the championship leader "unstoppable."

items.titleZh: 车手称马德里赛道首秀乏味：“我差点睡着了”
items.summaryZh: 在马德里赛道赛道完成F1首秀后，车手们对比赛过程反应冷淡，有车手表示“我差点睡着了”。车手们认为这条赛道存在主要问题，并提出了各自的解决方案。
items.titleEn: 'I almost fell asleep' - drivers react to dull Madring F1 debut
items.summaryEn: After making their F1 debut at the Madring circuit, drivers gave a lukewarm reaction to the race, with one saying "I almost fell asleep." Drivers identified main problems with the track and proposed their own solutions.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯西班牙大奖赛后拒绝官员可口可乐要求获赞
items.summaryZh: 在西班牙大奖赛赛后冷却室中，兰多·诺里斯拒绝了官员提出的不要饮用可口可乐的要求，F1车迷对此表示赞赏。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris praised for firm response to Coca-Cola request after Spanish GP: "Highlight of the Madring"
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris won praise from Formula 1 fans after firmly rejecting a request to put away a can of Coca-Cola in the cooldown room following the Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 2026年F1西班牙大奖赛赢家与输家盘点
items.summaryZh: The 比赛团队对2026年F1西班牙大奖赛进行赢家与输家盘点，指出在马德里赛道的首场F1比赛中真正的赢家不多，连获胜者本人都觉得自己应该排在第二位。
items.titleEn: Winners and losers from F1's 2026 Spanish Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: The Race team reviews the winners and losers from the 2026 Formula 1 Spanish Grand Prix, noting that there were not many true winners at the first F1 race at the Madring, and even the actual race winner felt he really deserved to be second.

items.titleZh: 罗斯伯格：塞恩斯作为马德里赛道大使应对超车难题分担责任
items.summaryZh: 2016年F1世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格表示，卡洛斯·塞恩斯作为马德里马德里赛道赛道的形象大使，应对该赛道超车困难的问题承担部分责任。2026年西班牙大奖赛在该赛道举行后，超车机会匮乏引发批评。
items.titleEn: Nico Rosberg: Carlos Sainz must share blame for Madring overtaking issues
items.summaryEn: 2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg says Carlos Sainz must take some responsibility for the lack of overtaking at the new Madring circuit, given his role as ambassador for the venue. The 2026 Spanish Grand Prix was held at the track, and its lack of overtaking opportunities was immediately criticised.

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔2026年F1争冠希望愈发渺茫
items.summaryZh: 在西班牙大奖赛上，拉塞尔连续第五次被梅赛德斯队友安东内利击败，他赢得2026年F1年度冠军的可能性被形容为“极其渺茫”。
items.titleEn: George Russell closer than ever to giving up on 2026 F1 title
items.summaryEn: George Russell is now "exceptionally unlikely" to win the 2026 Formula 1 title after being beaten by Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli for a fifth consecutive time at the Spanish Grand Prix. At F1's new Madring track, Russell qualified a lowly sixth, explaining he "tried pushing hard in Turn 11" but "the tyres couldn't take it."

items.titleZh: 红牛为要求维斯塔潘让回两个位置的决定辩护
items.summaryZh: 在F1西班牙大奖赛马德里站中，红牛车队指示维斯塔潘让回两个位置，最终他获得第二名。车队负责人Laurent Mekies认为，即便没有这一指令，维斯塔潘也难以取胜。
items.titleEn: Red Bull defends decision to force Max Verstappen to give back two positions
items.summaryEn: In the F1 Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid, Red Bull instructed Max Verstappen to give back two positions, and he ultimately finished second. Team boss Laurent Mekies believes that even without this instruction, Verstappen would not have been able to win.

items.titleZh: The 比赛评马德里首场F1大奖赛：巨大错失良机
items.summaryZh: The 比赛团队评价马德里首场F1大奖赛并不精彩，认为赛道缺乏超车机会，是一次巨大的错失良机。
items.titleEn: A massive missed opportunity - our verdict on first Madrid F1 race
items.summaryEn: The Race team reviewed Madrid's first Formula 1 race, calling it not a thriller and a big missed opportunity due to a lack of overtaking opportunities.

items.titleZh: 2026 F1西班牙大奖赛：安东内利领跑车手积分榜
items.summaryZh: 2026年F1西班牙大奖赛结束后，梅赛德斯车手K. Antonelli以292分排名车手积分榜第一。
items.titleEn: All the results and standings from the 2026 F1 Spanish Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: After the 2026 F1 Spanish Grand Prix, Mercedes driver K. Antonelli leads the drivers' standings with 292 points.

items.titleZh: 2026年西班牙大奖赛正赛集锦
items.summaryZh: 天空体育发布了2026年西班牙大奖赛正赛集锦。
items.titleEn: Spanish Grand Prix | Race highlights
items.summaryEn: Sky Sports has released highlights of the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 2026 F1西班牙大奖赛：安东内利扩大积分领先优势
items.summaryZh: 2026年F1西班牙大奖赛结束后，安东内利进一步扩大了对拉塞尔和汉密尔顿的积分领先优势。Russell在本站仅获第五，Hamilton则因刹车问题被迫退赛。
items.titleEn: 2026 F1 Championship standings: Kimi Antonelli closes in on the title
items.summaryEn: After the 2026 F1 Spanish Grand Prix, Kimi Antonelli has further extended his championship lead over George Russell and Lewis Hamilton. Russell could only finish fifth, while Hamilton was forced to retire due to a brake problem.

items.titleZh: F1 2026西班牙大奖赛马德里站正赛结果
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车手安东内利利用虚拟安全车（VSC）期间的进站机会，在马德里马德里赛道赛道举行的首届2026年西班牙大奖赛正赛中夺冠。
items.titleEn: F1 2026 Spanish Grand Prix race results at Madrid
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli won the inaugural 2026 Spanish Grand Prix at Madrid's Madring circuit, taking advantage of a pit stop during the virtual safety car (VSC) period.

items.titleZh: 安东内利赢得马德里首场F1比赛，诺里斯因虚拟安全车错失胜利
items.summaryZh: 在马德里举行的首场F1比赛中，安东内利赢得胜利。诺里斯和迈凯伦因进站时机问题，错失了本可能到手的胜利。
items.titleEn: Antonelli wins first Madrid F1 race after Norris VSC blow
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli won the first-ever Formula 1 race at the Madring, as Lando Norris and McLaren lost a likely victory due to their pitstop timing.

items.titleZh: 安东内利赢得首届西班牙马德里赛道大奖赛，诺里斯进站失误失利好运
items.summaryZh: 安东内利在马德里赛道举行的首届西班牙大奖赛中夺冠，受益于诺里斯在第14圈虚拟安全车期间的进站失误，将冠军领先优势扩大至81分。
items.titleEn: Spanish GP: Kimi Antonelli wins F1's first Madring race to increase title lead after Lando Norris misfortune
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli won the first Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring, benefiting from Lando Norris's pit-stop misfortune during a lap-14 Virtual Safety Car to extend his championship lead to 81 points.

items.titleZh: F1西班牙大奖赛：安东内利再夺冠，虚拟安全车令诺里斯痛失胜利
items.summaryZh: 在F1首次于马德里赛道赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛中，安东内利夺冠。杆位发车的诺里斯在比赛初段轻松拉开差距，但在虚拟安全车（VSC）出动后随即进站，导致名次大幅下滑，最终失去胜利。
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli won the Spanish Grand Prix, Formula 1's first race at the Madring, as polesitter Lando Norris lost the victory after pitting right after a virtual safety car intervention. Norris had comfortably pulled away in the early stages but the strategy call dropped him far back.

items.titleZh: F1西班牙大奖赛五大要点：安东内利再进一步
items.summaryZh: 在F1首次造访马德里赛道的西班牙大奖赛中，安东内利成为周末赢家，将冠军领先优势再扩大15分；梅赛德斯已连续第四场排位赛失利，但Antonelli表现无懈可击。
items.titleEn: Five quick takeaways from the F1 Spanish GP
items.summaryEn: At F1's first visit to the Madring for the Spanish Grand Prix, Kimi Antonelli emerged as the winner of the weekend, extending his championship lead by a further 15 points; Mercedes has now been beaten to pole for the fourth straight race, yet Antonelli delivered a faultless performance.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿马德里退赛后承认2026年冠军无望
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在2026年西班牙大奖赛因刹车故障退赛后表示，梅赛德斯和基米·安东内利今年“无法阻挡”，实际上承认了自己在2026年F1冠军争夺中的失利。
items.titleEn: Hamilton effectively concedes 2026 F1 title
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton retired from the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix with a brake failure and said there is "no stopping" Mercedes and Kimi Antonelli this season, effectively conceding the 2026 F1 title fight.

items.titleZh: 塞恩斯因与阿隆索碰撞被罚五秒
items.summaryZh: 卡洛斯·塞恩斯因与费尔南多·阿隆索发生碰撞，被处以五秒时间处罚。
items.titleEn: Spanish Grand Prix: Carlos Sainz handed five-second penalty for Fernando Alonso crash
items.summaryEn: Carlos Sainz was given a five-second time penalty for causing a collision with Fernando Alonso.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯因进站失误丢掉领先位置
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯在一系列不利事件后失去了比赛领先位置：他在虚拟安全车（VSC）期间错过了进站机会，随后迈凯伦车队的进站又非常缓慢。
items.titleEn: Spanish Grand Prix: Lando Norris loses lead after botched pitstop
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris lost the race lead after an unlucky sequence of events, missing a pitstop opportunity under a VSC before a very slow stop by McLaren.

items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿因刹车问题在西班牙大奖赛退赛
items.summaryZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在西班牙大奖赛中因刹车问题被迫提前退赛。
items.titleEn: Spanish Grand Prix: Lewis Hamilton forced to retire after brake issue in Madrid
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton was forced to retire early from the Spanish Grand Prix due to a brake issue.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘因一号弯与汉密尔顿事件在车队无线电中暴怒
items.summaryZh: 西班牙大奖赛上，马克斯·维斯塔潘在一号弯事件后因跑出赛道被车队要求将位置交还给刘易斯·汉密尔顿，随后他在红牛车队无线电中表达了强烈不满。
items.titleEn: Spanish GP: Max Verstappen FUMES after running off track in Lewis Hamilton incident
items.summaryEn: At the Spanish Grand Prix, Max Verstappen was told by Red Bull to give his position back to Lewis Hamilton after running off track in an incident at the first corner, and he expressed strong frustration over team radio.

items.titleZh: 西班牙大奖赛：安东内利首圈两次跑宽
items.summaryZh: 在西班牙大奖赛的首圈，安东内利两次跑出赛道宽度。
items.titleEn: Spanish Grand Prix: Kimi Antonelli goes wide TWICE on opening lap
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli went wide twice on the opening lap of the Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 西班牙大奖赛：安东内利夺冠与诺里斯的不幸遭遇引发反响

items.summaryZh: 维斯塔潘在F1西班牙大奖赛排位赛中位列第三，落后杆位得主诺里斯和梅赛德斯车手安东内利仅略超十分之一秒。他表示，鉴于马德里街道赛道超车极为困难，若要击败诺里斯夺冠，自己仍需弄清在哪里超车。
items.titleEn: Max Verstappen: ‘I need to figure out where to overtake’ to win F1 Spanish GP
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen qualified third for the F1 Spanish Grand Prix, just over a tenth slower than polesitter Lando Norris and Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli. He said he still needs to figure out where to overtake if he is to beat Norris to victory, given how difficult passing is expected to be at the Madring street circuit.

items.titleZh: 决定马德里首场F1比赛的5大因素
items.summaryZh: F1今日在马德里马德里赛道赛道迎来首场比赛，练习赛、排位赛及F2/F3垫场赛提供了一些线索，但缺乏历史数据意味着比赛仍可能充满意外。
items.titleEn: 5 factors that will dictate Madrid's first F1 race
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 heads into the unknown today at the new Madring circuit in Madrid for its first Spanish Grand Prix, with practice, qualifying and support races offering some clues but no racing history meaning surprises are possible.

items.titleZh: 科尔顿·赫塔退出马德里F2两回合比赛
items.summaryZh: 科尔顿·赫塔在F2马德里站周五排位赛中于第19号弯失控撞墙，随后退出周六和周日两回合比赛。据报道其感觉“身体不适”。
items.titleEn: Colton Herta withdraws from both Madring F2 races
items.summaryEn: Colton Herta has withdrawn from both races at the Madring Formula 2 round after crashing in Friday qualifying. His car damaged the front, rear and right-hand side when he hit both walls at Turn 19.

items.titleZh: 马德里大奖赛前瞻：高抓地力与高轮胎损耗成焦点，梅赛德斯调侃六停策略
items.summaryZh: F1车手首次造访马德里赛道时体验到出乎意料的高抓地力，同时极高的轮胎损耗同样令围场内多支车队感到意外。梅赛德斯领队托托·沃尔夫还就超长维修区带来的六停策略开玩笑，但实际上维修区过长反而更倾向于一停。
items.titleEn: What to expect from Madrid GP? From Mercedes' six-stop joke to a "six-kilometre-long" pitlane
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 drivers experienced a surprisingly high level of grip on their first visit to the Madrid circuit, while very high tyre degradation has equally surprised teams in the paddock. Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff joked about a six-stop strategy, though the extremely long pitlane in reality appears to favour a one-stopper.

items.titleZh: 前迈凯伦青训车手Ugochukwu加冕2026年F3年度冠军
items.summaryZh: 前迈凯伦F1青训车手Ugo Ugochukwu于周日加冕2026年F3年度冠军，击败奥迪青训车手Freddie Slater。两人此前还曾在冬季的FRECA赛事中争夺冠军，Ugochukwu同样胜出。
items.summaryEn: Former McLaren F1 junior Ugo Ugochukwu was crowned the 2026 Formula 3 champion on Sunday, defeating Audi protege Freddie Slater. The pair had previously fought for the Formula Regional European title over the winter, with Ugochukwu prevailing there as well.

items.titleZh: 年轻时的埃尔顿·塞纳如何让F1精英们抓狂
items.summaryZh: The 比赛的F1历史播客《F1 Rewind》第二集中，Edd Straw与Mark Hughes回顾了埃尔顿·塞纳从托勒曼到莲花车队时期的崛起，以及他如何令围场内的资深对手们大为恼火。
items.titleEn: When a young Ayrton Senna drove F1's elite crazy
items.summaryEn: The second episode of The Race's F1 Rewind podcast explores Ayrton Senna's early rise, focusing on how his strategic approach and speed unsettled established drivers and team management during his Lotus years.

items.titleZh: 阿隆索警告F1不能这样继续下去
items.summaryZh: 阿隆索对当前一代F1赛车在马德里新赛道受限感到失望，警告F1“不能这样继续下去”，并透露已与F1高层讨论加速规则改革。
items.titleEn: "F1 cannot continue this way" - Fernando Alonso sounds the alarm at Spanish GP home race
items.summaryEn: Alonso expressed disappointment with how the current generation of F1 cars is held back at the new Madring circuit, warning that F1 "cannot continue this way," and revealed he has held talks with F1 chiefs to fast-track rule changes.

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦加速争取兰比亚斯，F1围场高调会面引关注
items.summaryZh: 迈凯伦正加快行动，试图提前从红牛获得工程师詹皮耶罗·兰比亚斯，并在F1围场进行了一次刻意高调的会面以引起关注。

items.titleZh: 马德里F1西班牙大奖赛：倾斜的第12弯或成关键
items.summaryZh: 新增的马德里站本周末开赛前已在围场引发大量讨论，焦点集中在赛道安全问题以及第12弯La Monumental。
items.titleEn: Why Madring’s banked Turn 12 could be crucial in the Spanish GP
items.summaryEn: The new Madrid round has already sparked extensive discussion in the paddock ahead of this weekend, focusing on safety concerns and Turn 12, known as La Monumental.

items.titleZh: 皮亚斯特里称马德里排位赛表现“令人震惊”且“相当混乱”
items.summaryZh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在西班牙大奖赛排位赛后形容自己的表现“令人震惊”且“相当混乱”，他最终排名第七，而迈凯伦队友兰多·诺里斯则夺得杆位。皮亚斯特里整个周末在新马德里赛道都缺乏速度，除第三次练习赛外，他在马德里的任何一节练习赛或排位赛阶段都未能进入前六。
items.titleEn: “Pretty shocking”, “quite messy” – Oscar Piastri bewildered by poor Madring F1 qualifying
items.summaryEn: Oscar Piastri described his Spanish Grand Prix qualifying as "shocking" and "messy" after finishing seventh while McLaren team-mate Lando Norris took pole position. Piastri struggled for pace all weekend at the new Madring track, failing to break into the top six in any practice session or qualifying segment except FP3.

items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔称旧版法拉利引擎导致其在马德里排位赛失利

items.titleEn: Leclerc says old Ferrari engine cost him in Madrid qualifying
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc believes that not having Ferrari's latest ADUO 2 power unit specification was a key factor in his slip down the order in qualifying for the Spanish Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯0.011秒险胜夺西班牙大奖赛杆位，斯特拉盛赞
items.summaryZh: 诺里斯在西班牙大奖赛排位赛中以0.011秒的微弱优势击败安东内利夺得杆位，迈凯伦领队Andrea Stella对他的表现给予高度赞扬。
items.titleEn: Lando Norris lost “three tenths” on way to shock Madring F1 pole
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris took pole position at the Spanish Grand Prix by a mere 0.011s over Kimi Antonelli, drawing high praise from McLaren team principal Andrea Stella.

items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯在西班牙大奖赛排位赛中夺得杆位，其表现被F1车迷广泛称赞为“惊艳”。这位迈凯伦车手在马德里赛道赛道为周日的正赛锁定头名发车位，以仅0.011秒的优势击败梅赛德斯车队积分榜领先者基米·安东内利。红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘获得第三。

items.summaryEn: Lando Norris secured a surprise pole position for the Spanish Grand Prix, earning widespread praise from Formula 1 fans who called his performance "sensational." The McLaren driver took the top spot for Sunday's race at the Madring circuit, beating Mercedes championship leader Kimi Antonelli by just 0.011 seconds, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen third.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘谈如何改进马德里F1赛道：“如果给我赛道图……”

Criticism from drivers emerged after qualifying at the IFEMA complex in the Spanish capital.

items.titleZh: 林德布拉德西班牙站FP2撞车后称“我允许自己犯错”

Despite this, he qualified 10th and defended his right to make mistakes, noting that a chassis change affected his weekend.

items.titleZh: 西班牙大奖赛F1排位赛：赢家与输家
items.summaryZh: 在马德里赛道赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛排位赛中，诺里斯以0.011秒优势夺得杆位，皮亚斯特里表现挣扎，多位车手命运各异。

items.titleEn: George Russell explains how he ended up a lowly sixth in Madring F1 qualifying
items.summaryEn: George Russell has explained his poor qualifying performance in Formula 1's Spanish Grand Prix, having ended up a lowly sixth while Mercedes team-mate and title rival Kimi Antonelli took second. Russell set the pace in Q1 at Madrid's new street circuit but failed to improve as significantly as his opponents in the next two segments, ending up sixth, some three tenths down on his team-mate.

items.titleZh: F1马德里赛道首秀成谜 拉塞尔与汉密尔顿各持看法

items.titleEn: Spanish GP: F1 drivers braced for race-day mystery on Madring debut with tyre and overtaking uncertainties
